#  Parametric Plots

Plot function pair $(x(u), y(u))$.
see @fig-parametric for example.

```{julia}
#| label: fig-parametric
#| fig-cap: "Parametric Plots"

using Plots, Distributions, Random, Turing, Statistics

plot(
    sin,
    x -> sin(2x),
    0,
    2π,
    leg = false,
    fill = (0, :lavender)
)
```
